messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: AUTOPAGER_LATENCY_HIGH for /v1/generate-us-west (p95=1.8s, p99=3.2s) — SLO p99=1.5s. Alert group: autopager-latency. link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/xyz
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: page triggered -> requires acknowledgement
Alice H: acked. I'm on it, pulling graphs now.
Ben S: ack. i'll check autoscaler and sidecar queue depth.
Diane (on-call): I'm taking primary. quick check — any customer-facing errors?
Evan (SRE): No 5xx in prod traces. saw queue_depth spike on sidecar before latency jump. KV cache evictions up ~12% in last 5m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/route-latency
Carla M: traces show tokenizer service latency stretched for some requests — tokenization time increased ~2.1s for longest traces. Possible backlog at tokenizer pool.
Alice H: copying runbook: /runbooks/latency-tail. Starting mitigation: reduce max_batch_size for generator in us-west to 8 to lower queuing. Command: 
```
# PATCH rollout to reduce batch size
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_batch_size":8}' https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/pools/us-west/generator
```
Ben S: scaling up generator pools by +2 nodes as quick increase. kubectl snippet: 
```
kubectl scale deployment/gen-uswest --replicas=6 -n inference
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by Alice H (1/3). Will escalate in 10m if not recovered.
Diane (on-call): support-bot, ping support to flag top 10 tenants in us-west for potential SLA exposure. @support-bot please open a ticket.
support-bot: Created ticket RED-INC-3821, assigned to Support L2.
Evan (SRE): triggering kvcache warmup for hot prefixes (safe prefetch): 
```
redis-cli -h kv-redis-us-west --eval /ops/scripts/warmup.lua "hot_prefixes.json"
```
Carla M: tokenizer pod had two restarts in last 30m on node g3-4, investigating OOM logs briefly. posting pod logs: https://logs.redwood/pod/tokenizer-usw-22
Alice H: can confirm the batch size change landed and new pods started. watching p95/p99.
Ben S: autoscaler increase completed, +2 nodes are ready. queue_depth trending down.
Evan (SRE): kvcache warmup running, eviction rate dropping.
Alice H: p95 back to ~0.85s, p99 down to 0.95s over the last 3m. Metrics: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/route-latency?orgId=1&from=now-10m
Diane (on-call): good recovery. marking as acknowledged mitigation succeeded. anyone on next steps for RCA?
Carla M: will capture tokenizer OOM and restart reason, might be a revert candidate for the tokenizer memory change from last deploy.
Ben S: I'll follow up on autoscaler hysteresis and make the HPA more sensitive to queue length to avoid future bursts.
Alice H: I'll add a short-lived canary to test smaller batch sizes under load and include a perf test in the release pipeline.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Will auto-close thread in 30m unless new alerts.
Diane (on-call): filing follow-up ticket: INF-4829 (RCA + remediation). owners: Carla M (tokenizer), Ben S (autoscale tuning), Alice H (batching / release test).
Alice H: quick note to support team: customer-facing impact limited: 7 tenants saw degraded latency for ~6 minutes; support ticket created.
Evan (SRE): leaving a short runbook tweak suggestion: add kvcache warmup step to autopilot for prefix hotness threshold.
Carla M: grabbing logs and starting RCA doc now.
Diane (on-call): thanks team. leaving primary on-call to Alice H in 15m. please keep updates in the thread if anything reappears. :thumbsup:
